name: Indonesian filler lexicon
description: Words that carry no meaning and can be cut when they stand alone. Matching is case-insensitive on the trimmed, punctuation-stripped token. Multi-word entries are matched on the joined token sequence.
notes: 'apa', 'ya', 'kan', 'nah' are context-dependent. They are only cut when they appear as an isolated token between pauses, never when adjacent to content words.
The doNotCut list guards against removing a negation or conjunction, which reverses meaning.
